thread:
rebecca: Opening a focused PR to add a short troubleshooting section for batching + prefetch with q4 quant profiles. Goal: one-paragraph symptom, three presets, and copy-paste SDK snippets. Not a deep dive.

tony: Thumbs up. Can you paste the exact snippets so reviewers can just copy them?

rebecca: Yep. Draft JS snippet for short-prefix preset:

```js
// short-prefix safe preset
await client.optimize.apply({
  model: 'redwood/q4-fast-v2',
  batching: { strategy: 'microbatch', maxBatchMs: 8 },
  cache: { prefetch: { enabled: false } }
});
```

harper: And Python equivalent? Also add the console path for support.

rebecca: Python snippet:

```py
# short-prefix safe preset
client.optimize.apply(
  model='redwood/q4-fast-v2',
  batching={'strategy': 'microbatch', 'max_batch_ms': 8},
  cache={'prefetch': {'enabled': False}}
)
```

tony: Console path: Console > Optimize > Pipelines > Caching > Prefetch (toggle). Add that so support can point customers.

rebecca: Adding that. I also plan two more presets in a tiny decision table: long-stream -> prefetch=true + continuous batching; embeddings -> prefetch=true (no q4 caveat).

harper: Please include a one-line troubleshooting checklist for quick copy: 1) disable prefetch for q4_fast, 2) try microbatch 5-15ms, 3) run smoke and check p95_first_token.

rebecca: Will do. Draft test command to include in examples: `python examples/opt/prefetch_smoke.py --profile=q4_fast --preset=short-prefix`. CI will assert p95_first_token < 180ms after warmup.

docs-helper: Suggest adding a tiny NOTE about tokenization variance increasing short-prefix length; link to the tokenizer doc. Keep wording neutral: "observed first-token latency".

rebecca: Good call. I'll add a one-line link to docs/tokenization/notes.md. Also attaching internal perf job 2712 for numbers and a CSV artifact.

ci-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/pull/3472 by rebecca  labels: docs:optimize, needs-ml-review, examples. CI: docs-lint passed, examples-smoke queued.

tony: When you open the PR, add `qa:flaky-tolerant` as a label since the smoke is timing-sensitive. Also include the branch name in the PR title.

rebecca: Branch `docs/prefetch-shortfix-2890012345`. Labels added. Aiming to merge after one ML + one Docs approval. I'll ping folks in the PR.

harper: If merged, please add a single-line changelog entry under Optimize v2 migration: "Prefetch guidance for q4-family quant profiles."

rebecca: Will add changelog and post a short summary in #eng-ml after merge with artifact links. Thanks everyone.
